about: Persistent attributes (01-model-danych.md §3.1, `P`; zadania/zrobione/TASK-01.md N5, N6): every RW,P attribute, the common ones included, is stored under a<endpoint>.<id> as its bytes on the wire when a write succeeds, and loaded before Booted. A stored PowerOnBehaviour = OFF beats the profile's RESTORE — the setting the hub wrote survives the power cut it was meant for. A factory reset erases the stored settings; the outputs' own state (output4) is not a setting and stays.
